status: frozen after predictor-only join audit and before reading BCG acceleration outcomes
question: Does an outcome-blind measured coherence proxy improve transfer or held-out prediction when CPR0 uses a local baryonic density rather than mean enclosed density?

selection: finite positive radius, effective radius, Sersic n, gbar, and gobs

coherence.observable: DynPop Lambda_Re, beam-corrected projected specific stellar angular momentum inside the elliptical half-light isophote
coherence.leakage_rule: No gobs, gbar residual, halo fit, missing-mass estimate, or CPR0 prediction enters C.
coherence.limitation: Lambda_Re is a projected proxy for, not an exact measurement of, C_kin=v_stream^2/(v_stream^2+tr sigma^2); it shares the MaNGA kinematic data source with the Jeans outcome.

local_density.shape: Prugniel-Simien deprojection of the published Sersic n and Re
local_density.normalization: Mbar(<r)=gbar*r^2/G at the published last kinematic radius
declared_systematics: Prugniel-Simien is an analytic approximation to exact Sersic deprojection
reported gas fraction is below 3.2 percent
a 20 percent density-normalization sensitivity is reported

heldout_test.fit_objective: unweighted training mean squared log10 acceleration residual
models: measured-coherence CPR0 cross-validated with fixed Sigma B=1.1725

claim_boundary: This is a spherical one-radius-per-BCG diagnostic, not a field-equation solution.
The BCG outcome is dynamics, not lensing; lensing remains a separate required track.
A held-out fit tests empirical predictiveness, not parameter universality across galaxies and clusters.
Failure of Lambda_Re does not falsify every possible coherence observable, but it rejects this predeclared mapping.
